q: Leading a Commercial Team on a programme and responsible for fulfilling the requirements of the Commercial function ensuring projects are delivered on time and in budget, including optimising performance while protecting the business from commercial risk. As a senior leader of the function, the role works closely with all stakeholders of the business, providing strategic commercial direction in the management of the project, functional and business goals.
Leading Pre-Contract commercial activities including RFP preparation and PTC responses
Develop a Commercial delivery plan for the programme / project ensuring the delivery thereof.
Ultimate responsibility for cost plan accuracy, interrogation, updates and coordination to ensure robust cost plans are submitted to the business on-time.
Comprehensively interrogate and manage the project cost report(s) for submission on a monthly basis in accordance with the reporting calendar and advise on key issues.
Manage design costs (Expenditure and CAPEX) against approved / estimated budgets
Validate and challenge Contractors and Vendors’ execution plans.

Ensure that all PR requisition forms are raised in a timely manner as required to achieve the schedule. Manage this process through the approval process to ensure that all queries / questions from the business are actively and timely responded to so PR’s are fully approved to allow Contracts / variations to be issued and Purchase orders issued on time.

Review all IPC’s to ensure they are accurate and processed on time to avoid payment delays or disputes. Accountable for actively managing the payment process by responding to questions from the business and swift resolution.
Lead the implementation and management of the Change Management process as per the Process & Procedures of the business, including all required documentation
Ensure the full change packs and approvals have been achieved and submitted to the Central Change Committee as per the prescribed schedule
Support the presentation of change at the Change Committee, ensuring all Change is explained and challenged for consideration against the recommendation
Review the effectiveness of the Change procedures and propose improvements as necessary.
Ability to investigate causes of delays and loss / expense, construct detailed legal arguments in respect of refuting entitlements, where not warranted, leading to the resolution of the issues.
Lead the timely assessment of Claims determinations provided by the Project Management Consultants, for presentation to the Change Committee.
Quantification and Costing of Construction Works
Ability to lead, monitor and guide at functional level the preparation of full quantification and cost data preparation for multiple complex projects accurately and swiftly.
Review and validate quantities and rates providing challenge where appropriate
Skilled negotiator able to lead a negotiating team in relation to complex projects, and secure acceptable commercial results.
Ability to autonomously negotiate / resolve difficult final account claims with all parties to the contract to optimise commercial benefit to SEVEN
Ability to manage a dispute through any form of dispute resolution process with practical knowledge and understanding of all legal techniques attached thereto.
Ensure compliance with SEVEN’s policies, procedures, management, and regulatory requirements.
Manage the implementation of business-wide procedures for the function, across all Projects
Periodically undertake internal compliance audits to ensure that the Consultants are adhering to SEVEN Policies & Procedures
Ensure progress is not delayed by the Main Contractor as a result of delayed Contract Administration
Interpret complex contractual clauses for contracts. Conversant in, and has the ability to negotiate in industry terms, bonds, warranties, guarantees, insurances, and other contractual mechanisms.
Ensure the updating correspondence registers, reviews of all correspondence and ensure all responses are issued on time. (correspondence received by SEVEN)
Ensure all provisional sum procurement is procured in accordance with SEVEN procedures and complaint with the agreed schedule.
Review all Final Accounts to ensure full contract compliance and commercial benefit to SEVEN
Represent SEVEN Commercial interactions with all directly engaged Contractors, Client Representatives, and Professional teams.
Management of Cost Consultants and PMC Commercial Consultants and all deliverables

Produce monthly consultant evaluations against contracted scopes and general performance expectations and arrange monthly feedback session to drive performance improvement. Formally issue the evaluation to the Consultants for record purposes.
Proposes actions in response to changes in client and stakeholder needs and expectations.
Professionally network within and beyond SEVEN and draw on these contacts as required.
Develop trust by building shared agendas with others. Use these to advance the business/function.
Initiate identified and valuable business relationships, developing these over time.
Ensure transparent and efficient communication with all members of SEVEN supporting their requirements
Implement and execute the Commercial Strategy & action plan
Contribute to the planning and execution of the strategic vision, goals and execution road map
Ensure effective support is provided to the overall business, engaged in the development of the Business Plan together with the individual Projects’ Business Cases & Strategies
Contribute to developing KPI’s for the Business, Project and Function aligning with Project / Business Execution Plans and the function strategy.
Manage commercial matters and issues, executing appropriate technical / non-technical solutions.
Simplify complex issues and develop scenarios to enable Responsible Decision Making
Ensure the DoA is respected and adhered under all circumstance
Review contract documentation and provide contractual support as a subject matter expert
Ensure that all securities, Insurance and warranties are in place in accordance with the contractual obligations of stakeholders. Ensure that compliance is maintained.
Expedite Provisional Sum procurement for approval.
Oversight and coordination of the tendering of provisional sums and selection process, in accordance with the policies and procedures of the business

Ensure IPC’s are accurate and processed on time to avoid payment delays or disputes. Communicate with vendors to drive improvement and with workflow approvers and Finance to ensure payments are processed on time.
Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Building, Engineering Degree or equivalent.

A minimum of 15 years of experience in Commercial Management within the Real Estate Industry, specifically construction and/or development, 5 to 10 years of which has been spent in managerial positions.
Ability to support the Executive Management in strategic and operational decisions.
Ability to understand and implement key systems and process.
Competent with key leadership priorities and engaging several stakeholders (internal / external).
Ability to create high-performing teams and lead the performance of individuals collectively.
Technical commercial leadership, in all aspects.
Highly effective communication, management, presentation and listening abilities.
Robust interpersonal skills, social intelligence and political acumen.

x: At STARTRADER, we combine trusted foundations with advanced technology to empower traders worldwide. As a global brand operating across 200+ regions and regulated by leading authorities, we provide secure access to 1,000+ CFDs through platforms such as MT4, MT5, STAR Copy, and the award-winning STARTRADER app.

Our international presence is strengthened through strategic collaborations, including our role as an Official Partner of the NBA, Official Partner of Porsche Carrera Cup Middle East, and Official Partner of the UAE National Cricket Team for the ICC Men's T20 World Cup.

Since our launch in 2019, our vision has been to make trading more accessible, trusted, and empowering - shaping both our products and our culture as we continue to grow by listening, evolving, and supporting our global community.

STARTRADER is the brand representing a network of regulated and licensed entities across various jurisdictions, each authorised to provide specific financial services in compliance with local regulations. STARTRADER Global Financial Consultation & Financial Analysis (Dubai-based entity) is licensed and regulated by the Capital Market Authority in the UAE to conduct promotion and client introduction activities only. All trading services are provided by STARTRADER entities regulated in other jurisdictions

The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy for Startrader across brand, content, social media, email marketing, events and demand generation. The role builds Startrader's market presence among institutional clients and generates qualified pipeline for the sales team. Positioned within the Global Marketing team, the role works closely with group marketing functions to apply shared resources and brand standards, while aligning marketing priorities with Startrader's commercial objectives through a reporting line to the Head of Marketing.
